summary: Enhance decision-making skills with our Data Analytics for Managerial Decision Making Course. Gain valuable insights for effective business strategies.
lede: Data analysis for managerial decision-making uses business data and analytical methods to support choices about performance, resources, risk, and priorities. Designed for professionals who use operational, financial, customer, or workforce data, the course develops skills in framing business questions, assessing data quality, and choosing suitable analytical methods. Practice includes KPI design, Excel and introductory SQL analysis, Power BI dashboards, forecasting, and communicating recommendations with evidence.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who use operational, financial, customer, or workforce data to recommend actions and explain performance. It suits foundation-level learners and managers with practical experience who want a stronger analytical workflow without becoming specialist data scientists.
audience: Sales Managers using pipeline, revenue, and retention
prerequisites: You need basic familiarity with spreadsheets, tables, charts, and workplace performance reports. Coding is not required for completion. The course provides practice datasets and templates, while optional access to Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Power BI supports the hands-on exercises. You may use a sanitized organizational dataset if your employer permits it.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
